items.headline: Trump admin unveils anti-Iran global sanctions plan, signals China not exempt
items.summary: The Trump administration unveiled a plan to isolate Iran's economy by threatening to impose secondary sanctions on the Islamic Republic's "enablers."

items.headline: A massive trade just happened in gold. The options market is buzzing

items.headline: NVIDIA Earnings: A Quick Look at Expectations
items.summary: Looming large this week is none other than AI-favorite NVIDIA (NVDA), whose results will wrap up the reporting cycle for the Magnificent Seven group as well.

items.headline: Crypto extends gains after biggest 3-day rally since 2023
items.summary: Bitcoin and crypto stocks extended their rally after the flagship cryptocurrency broke out of its trading range.

items.headline: Nasdaq Drops as Market Bets Against AI Ahead of Nvidia Earnings
items.summary: Technology stocks tumbled again on Monday because Wall Street is worried about artificial intelligence shares ahead of another key earnings test.  The Nasdaq Composite fell 0.8%.  The Dow, which lacks the exposure to AI that the Nasdaq and S&P have, managed to claw its way higher despite the latest escalations between the U.S. and Canada on trade.

items.headline: Amazon’s latest price move comes with a nasty surprise
items.summary: Amazon shoppers are paying more for a hidden tech problem.

items.headline: Oil prices fall as Bessent outlines new steps to punish Iran
items.summary: Oil prices retreated as US Treasury Secretary outlined plans for more sanctions to punish Iran while stock markets mostly faltered on Monday as investors looked ahead to key US inflation data and earnings from Nvidia.Earlier, Asian markets were hit by a fresh wave of pressure on technology stocks, with investors awaiting Wednesday's earnings report from Nvidia.

items.headline: Google plans to move all Pixel manufacturing out of China by 2027: report
items.summary: Google Pixel manufacturing is reportedly moving entirely out of China to Vietnam and India by 2027, affecting smartphones, watches and earbuds in the supply chain shift.

items.headline: Supreme Court allows some Trump vote-by-mail limits ahead of midterm election
items.summary: The unsigned order lifted an injunction covering 23 states and Washington, D.C.; the court’s three liberal justices dissented.

items.headline: Mark Walter's TWG Global hires Goldman veteran Markowitz as top lawyer amid probe of insurers
items.summary: Federal authorities are investigating how two insurers that are part of Mark Walter's business empire classified more than $20 billion in loans to his companies.

items.headline: Yields decline on CNBC report Treasury could use General Account to fund buybacks

items.headline: US stocks today: S&P 500, Nasdaq decline as tech sector falls, US prepares to impose more Iran sanctions
items.summary: Wall Streets S&P 500 and Nasdaq declined on Monday, dragged down by a sharp sell-off in technology and semiconductor stocks.Investors reacted to fresh U.S. sanctions against Iran, mounting political pushback on AI data centers, and looming market catalysts, including Nvidias earnings and upcoming Fed inflation reports.

recs.market_summary: Mercado mixto: el S&P 500 (SPY) está en Stage 2 pero con señales mixtas, mientras que el Nasdaq (QQQ) se muestra débil por apuestas contra IA antes de los earnings de NVIDIA. Los ADRs argentinos (BBAR, GGAL, LOMA, CEPU, PAMP, TECO2, YPFD) suben fuerte impulsados por la noticia del proyecto de LNG financiado por JPMorgan y Santander. El oro (GLD) sigue fuerte con una operación masiva en opciones. Las tensiones con Irán presionan al petróleo (USO) a la baja.
